class_secondary_max_003.answer: Advisory groups: maximum 15 students. Summer school: approximately 30 students per teacher.
class_secondary_max_003.evidence: It is highly recommended that all Advisory groups be limited to no more than 15 students. Good faith efforts will be made to keep the summer school class sizes at approximately thirty (30) students per teacher

class_overage_remedy_004.evidence: If an Advisory group exceeds 15 students due to staffing issues, the school shall schedule all Advisory groups with the smallest number of students possible, equitably distributed among all advisors.
